text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: AUTO-PAGE fired for host gpu-node-42 (rack-7). Alert: kernel panic -> kubelet NotReady. PagerDuty incident INC-2026-3045 created and notified @maria (oncall).

maria (oncall): acked. I'm taking primary. quick ask: any customer impact noted yet?

jordan: seeing model-serving retries increase on pool 'hosted-gpu-1' for the last 2m, ~10% error retries. grafana link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/serving/latency?var-node=gpu-node-42

maria (oncall): thanks. pulling serial logs now, attaching output.

maria (oncall): ```
Serial console (gpu-node-42):
[ 1234.567890] Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception in interrupt
[ 1234.567900] CPU: 3 PID: 0 Comm: swapper/3 Not tainted 5.10.0-rt
[ 1234.567910] Call Trace:
  dump_stack+0x65/0x88
  panic+0x1b3/0x32a
```

maria (oncall): kernel panic looks real. SSH to host is failing. Host is unresponsive to agent pings but BMC is reachable.

ben.sre: can you `kubectl get nodes gpu-node-42 -o wide` and cordon it? we should drain any critical pods and failover traffic.

maria (oncall): doing `kubectl cordon gpu-node-42` -> `kubectl drain gpu-node-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` in progress. posting output: some serving pods are evicted, others rescheduled to dedicated-gpu-pool-2.

carla: pinging infra for RMA/serial reset. rack ops says they'll attempt a soft power-cycle via IPMI now.

pagerduty-bot: INC-2026-3045 acknowledged by maria (oncall). Escalation to ben.sre in 10m if not resolved.

jordan: early customer impact: a subset of small-embedding requests saw elevated latency and 5xx retries between 7054321900-7054322050; overall platform error rate +0.7% but most traffic recovered after reschedule. opening a customer-impact note on the incident ticket.

maria (oncall): update: IPMI soft-powercycle returned host to BMC but kernel panic persists on boot. Boot logs show same oops. marking host as 'needs RMA' and creating ticket with vendor.

ben.sre: good. I'm taking runbook step 'hot-host-failure' -> schedule replacement and cordon remains. Also add fallback routing to dedicated capacity for critical customers: tagging routes `--route-priority=dedicated-failover` for affected service.

carla: RMA ticket filed: RMA-88172, vendor ETA 48h due to spare state.

maria (oncall): handoff: I'm going to wrap stabilization and hand to night oncall at 7054322200. Night: continue RMA coordination and update PD incident status. Postmortem ticket created: https://board.redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-3045.

jordan: noted. add eval to Optimize to check if batching/kv-cache could prevent the retry spike in future.

maria (oncall): final notes for handoff: affected pool: hosted-gpu-1 (minor traffic degradation, automated fallback worked; no major data loss), actions taken: cordon+drain, IPMI soft reset, RMA raised, PD incident active. assigning followups: RMA coordination -> carla, postmortem owner -> ben.sre.

pagerduty-bot: Incident status: acknowledged -> in_progress. Next escalation in 4h if unresolved. :white_check_mark:
